prompt: How do I create a team site in SharePoint?
completion:
## How to Create a Team Site in SharePoint

Below is a step‑by‑step guide for creating a **modern team site** in SharePoint Online (Office 365).  
If you’re using SharePoint Server (2019/2016/2013) the steps are similar but use the Central Administration console.

> **Prerequisites**  
> • You must have a Microsoft 365 or SharePoint Online subscription.  
> • You need at least **SharePoint administrator** or **global administrator** permissions (or the *Site Collection Administrator* role for the target site collection).  
> • The user creating the site will automatically become the site owner and can add members/owners.

---

## 1. Create a Team Site via the SharePoint App Launcher (Modern UI)

1. **Open Office 365**  
   - Go to <https://www.office.com> and sign in with your credentials.

2. **Open SharePoint**  
   - Click the app launcher (nine dots) in the upper‑left corner → **SharePoint**.

3. **Start the New Site wizard**  
   - In the SharePoint home page, click **+ New** → **Team site**.

4. **Fill in the site details**  
   | Field | What to put |
   |-------|-------------|
   | **Site name** | The display name of the site (e.g., *Marketing Team*). |
   | **Site address** | Auto‑generated URL; you can edit it (e.g., `https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/MarketingTeam`). |
   | **Description** | Optional: a brief description of the site’s purpose. |
   | **Privacy** | Choose *Private – Only members can access* (recommended) or *Public – Anyone in your organization can access*. |
   | **Language** | Pick your preferred language. |

5. **Add site owners and members**  
   - Add the Office 365 groups or individual users who should be *Owners* (full control) or *Members* (edit rights).  
   - You can also click **Add owners** / **Add members** later in the **Site permissions** pane.

6. **Create the site**  
   - Click **Finish**. SharePoint creates the site in a few seconds.

7. **Post‑creation setup** (optional but recommended)  
   - **Add a logo** → *Site logo* (top left).  
   - **Choose a theme** → *Change the look* → pick a color palette and background image.  
   - **Add essential web parts** → *Documents*, *News*, *Announcements*, etc.  
   - **Set up libraries** → Configure document libraries with versioning, content types, and metadata as needed.  
   - **Create a site map** → *Site Contents* → *Site map* to aid navigation.

---

## 2. Create a Team Site via the SharePoint Admin Center (Batch/Advanced)

If you’re a SharePoint admin and need to create many sites quickly:

1. Sign in to the **Microsoft 365 Admin Center** as a global or SharePoint admin.
2. Go to **SharePoint** → **Admin center**.
3. Click **Sites** → **Active sites** → **+ Create**.
4. Pick **Team site** as the template.
5. Fill in the same fields as in the wizard (name, address, privacy).
6. Optionally, set **Site settings** like site collection storage quota, resource quota, or compliance settings.
7. Click **Finish**.

**Tip:** Use PowerShell (`SharePointPnPPowerShellOnline` or `Microsoft.Online.SharePoint.PowerShell`) for bulk site creation:

```powershell
Connect-SPOService -Url https://contoso-admin.sharepoint.com
New-SPOSite -Url https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/MarketingTeam -Owner "admin@contoso.com" -Title "Marketing Team" -Template "STS#3" -StorageQuota 1000
```

---

## 3. Create a Team Site from Microsoft Teams

If your team already uses Microsoft Teams, you can automatically spin up a corresponding SharePoint team site:

1. In Teams, click **Teams** → **Join or create a team** → **Create a team** → **From scratch** or **From an existing group**.  
2. Choose **Private** or **Public** (mirrors SharePoint privacy).  
3. Provide a **Team name** and **Description**.  
4. Add members.  
5. The first time you add a tab or file, Teams creates a SharePoint team site behind the scenes (URL: `https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/<TeamName>`).  
6. You can access that site by clicking **Files** tab → **Open in SharePoint**.

---

## 4. For On‑Premise SharePoint (2019/2016/2013)

1. Open **Central Administration** → **Application Management** → **Create site collections**.  
2. Choose **Team Site** as the template.  
3. Provide site collection name, URL, owner, storage quota, and version.  
4. Create the collection.  
5. Log in as the owner to set up libraries, permissions, and navigation.

---

## 5. Managing Permissions After Creation

| Role | Typical Permissions | How to Manage |
|------|---------------------|---------------|
| **Owner** | Full control of the site (create/modify content, manage permissions). | *Site Settings* → *Site permissions* → *Edit Permissions* |
| **Member** | Edit items, add/delete content. | Same as Owner, but remove *Full control* rights. |
| **Visitor** | Read‑only. | *Site permissions* → *Edit Permissions* → assign *Read* permission. |

You can also **link SharePoint groups** to Microsoft 365 groups for easier management.

---

## 6. Quick Checklist

- [ ] Decide on **site name** and **URL**.  
- [ ] Choose **privacy** (private is recommended for team sites).  
- [ ] Add **owners** and **members** immediately.  
- [ ] Apply a **theme** and logo.  
- [ ] Set up essential libraries (Docs, Images, etc.) with versioning.  
- [ ] Configure **site navigation** (quick launch, top link bar).  
- [ ] Enable **search** and **content types** if needed.  
- [ ] Set up **co‑authoring** and **check‑in/check‑out** settings for documents.  

---

### Need More Help?

- **Microsoft Learn**: “Create a SharePoint site” tutorial.  
- **SharePoint Community**: Ask questions on the SharePoint Stack Exchange.  
- **Admin Docs**: “Manage SharePoint permissions” – Microsoft Docs.

By following these steps, you’ll have a fully‑functional team site ready for collaboration in minutes!
